claims.explanation: Buphenine is a beta-adrenergic agonist whose selectivity likely depends on ADRB2 expression and downstream cAMP signaling, since lines with active adrenergic/cAMP pathways (e.g., BRAF-mutant melanoma, KRAS-mutant colorectal/pancreatic lines) are enriched among sensitive lines while STK11/KEAP1-mutant lung lines and several squamous lines are resistant. Co-occurring PI3K pathway activation (PIK3CA mutation/PTEN loss) may further sensitize by cooperating with cAMP-driven growth suppression or metabolic stress. The pattern is best explained by ADRB2/cAMP-pathway competence plus PI3K-pathway alterations rather than by a single lineage.

features.basis: buphenine is an ADRB2 agonist; target expression required for response
BRAF-mutant melanoma lines SH4 and IPC298 are among most killed
KRAS-mutant colorectal, pancreatic, and lung lines enriched among sensitive lines
PIK3CA-mutant lines (T47D, MKN1, HCC1954, LU99, GP2D) are enriched among sensitive lines
PTEN loss co-occurs in several sensitive lines (SF295, H4, NCIH1339, GP2D)
STK11-mutant lung/esophageal lines (NCIH1623, G361, TE4) are among least affected
KEAP1-mutant NCIH1623 is among least affected lines
NFE2L2-mutant esophageal lines KYSE520 and TE6 show discordant response, with TE6 resistant
SMARCA4-mutant lines (COV434, NCIH1793, KYSE270, SKNSH) are among least affected
ARID1A-mutant lines (T47D, GP2D, LOVO) appear among sensitive lines
TP53 mutation is common across sensitive lines but also common in resistant lines, so weak
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines HCC4006 and NCIH1339 are among sensitive lines
